decisions.executionNote: Raise and unfold the left arm elbow-up toward the left tube; keep right arm parked. Tube yaw differs from reference, to align during approach.
Continue the left elbow-up arc with reduced increments; progressively yaw the open gripper to match the diagonal tube.
Move above the left tube and finish downward approach orientation, matching its cap-to-tip direction. Leave vertical clearance before closing.
Descend with open fingers to the tube body, making a small capward centering correction; inspect before gripping.
Refine the diagonal tube alignment and center the body between the fingers, then close the left gripper fully.
Lift the first tube clear of the table while maintaining closure; inspect retention and its slight angular offset before rack insertion.
Tube remains between the fingers. Begin turning it upright and transferring toward a left-side rack slot with ample height.
Complete the upright rotation over the left rack slot, retaining the tube and keeping clearance above the rack.
Lower the upright first tube into the left-front large slot, with a small forward centering correction. Keep grasp closed until depth is checked.
Seat the first tube a little deeper, then open the gripper and observe whether it remains upright in the slot.
Withdraw the open left gripper from the first tube while beginning an elbow-up right-arm approach to the outer right tube.
The first tube appears to have toppled after release; reserve it for recovery. Continue toward the outer right tube while clearing the left arm safely.
Align the right gripper downward around the outer tube, descending to body height. Continue retracting the open left arm without changing elbow branch.
Center the right tube in the wrist view and close around its body. Finish returning the left arm close to its origin.
Lift the right tube clear while holding fully closed; keep the left arm at its origin. Verify stable retention before rotating upright.
Carry the retained right tube toward the right-front rack slot while rotating upright in small continuous increments.
Continue upright rotation with the right tube securely held, approaching the rack from its right side.
Finish turning the second tube vertical and pause above the rack for precise slot alignment, without releasing.
Lower toward the right-front slot while correcting slightly inward and forward; keep holding to inspect tube-to-hole alignment before release.
Insert vertically into the aligned right-side large slot, still holding closed for depth and alignment inspection.
Tube appears to contact the rack rather than seat fully. Relieve the contact, shift slightly forward into the slot, and lower again without releasing.
Use the visible hole rim to make a small inward correction and lower the tube tip into the opening, keeping the grip closed.
Avoid pressing against the rack. Lift and shift toward the adjacent large opening, correcting the tube axis seen just inside the right-front slot.
The tube tip is now over a large opening. Lower slightly and open so it can settle into the rack; lift the fingers clear and check retention.
Withdraw the open right hand upward and back from the upright tube. Check that it stays seated before approaching the remaining right-side tube.
One tube remains upright in the rack. Raise and turn the open right gripper toward the remaining diagonal right-side tube, clear of the seated tube.
Continue the right-arm approach above the loose diagonal tube, rotating toward a downward grasp while maintaining table clearance.
Finish the downward orientation and descend around the diagonal tube body with the fingers open for a visual centering check.
Fine-center the diagonal tube, lower the fingers around its body, and close the right gripper fully.
Lift the third tube clear while keeping the right gripper closed, then verify retention before transfer.
Turn the retained tube upright and transfer toward a central large slot, staying to the right of the left arm and clear of the seated tube.
Continue the controlled transfer and upright rotation above the central rack area; retain the tube and avoid the occupied right slot.
Finish upright alignment above the middle large slot, maintaining clearance from the occupied right slot.
Lower the upright tube toward the central opening while holding closed, then inspect the tip and hole rim before seating.
Continue a slow vertical insertion into the central large slot. Watch for tube slip or rim contact before opening the gripper.
The tube has contacted the rack surface. Lift slightly and align with the front central large opening rather than pushing against the plate.
The large opening is visible beneath the tube. Make a small lateral centering adjustment and open gradually so the tube can settle into the slot.
Withdraw from the second seated tube and begin an elbow-up left-arm approach to recover the fallen tube in front of the rack.
Approach the fallen tube from the left with clearance, turning to match its reversed cap direction. Return the right arm away from the rack.
Continue the left approach with the gripper above the loose tube, checking configuration continuity as the wrist turns. Retract the right arm toward home.
Bring the left gripper above the fallen tube while continuing its cap-direction alignment; finish returning the right arm to origin.
The wrist reached its angle-wrap boundary. Unwind in the continuous opposite direction above the table before completing the recovery grasp; finish the right-arm return.
Continue unwinding the left wrist while correcting the approach axis to vertical above the fallen tube. Maintain clearance and open fingers.
Continue the safe wrist unwind above the tube, keeping the downward approach axis and elbow-up posture unchanged.
Continue the continuous wrist rotation toward the fallen tube's cap direction, centering above its body with clearance.
Complete most of the remaining cap-direction rotation while lowering slightly toward the recovery grasp, with the fingers still open.
Align the recovered tube vertically in the wrist view and move capward to center its body between the open fingers before closing.
Fine-center and lower the left fingers around the recovered tube, then close fully while keeping the wrist away from its wrap boundary.
Lift the recovered tube away from the rack and table while holding closed. Verify retention before the longer upright rotation.
Begin a slow continuous upright rotation of the recovered tube, unwinding the wrist and moving left of the occupied slots.
Continue rotating the retained tube toward upright with height clearance, keeping the wrist motion continuous and the right arm parked.
